title: OcoOrderLeg
description: OCO order leg as returned by `/api/v4/oco-orders` and `/api/v4/order/oco-cancel`. Field names use snake_case (`post_only`, `activation_price`) — unlike the camelCase legs returned by `/api/v4/conditional-orders`.

clientOrderId.description: Custom order identifier. Empty string if not specified

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in seconds (UTC) of order creation, with microsecond precision.

feeAsset.description: Currency ticker of the asset used to pay the trading fee. Omitted when empty.

status.description: Order status (for example `OPEN` for an active leg, `CANCELED` after cancellation).

stp.description: Self-trade prevention mode. Possible values: `no`, `cb`, `cn`, `co`. Always returned in abbreviated form, even when the request used a legacy value.

positionSide.description: Position side of the leg. Present on futures markets (`BOTH` in one-way mode, `LONG`/`SHORT` in hedge mode); omitted on margin-spot markets.

reduceOnly.description: Reduce-only flag. When `true`, the leg can only reduce or close an existing position.

mtime.description: Unix timestamp in seconds (UTC), with microsecond precision, of the last time the matching engine modified the order.

activation_price.description: Activation price. Returned on the stop-loss leg

activation_condition.description: Trigger condition derived from `side` (response-only, cannot be overridden): `buy` → `gte`, `sell` → `lte`. Returned on the stop-loss leg.

activated.description: Activation status (0 - not activated, 1 - activated). Returned on the stop-loss leg
